row.notes: Whole body read. Returns if the name string at control+0xa8 is NULL or empty. Takes the int at +0x40 of the component with type 0x146ca5498 on the control (+0x30..+0x38) or, if absent, on the nearest ancestor (+0x20 chain) that has one; builds hash = (id*33 + '.') then x33 over the name; looks that up in the swiss-table registry of g_Vm_UiSystem vt+0x68 (+0xa8 seed, +0xb0 slots, +0xb8 ctrl, +0xc8 mask). If a target is found and its flag 0x800 (u32 at +0x198) differs from on: sets the flag, mirrors it to bit 0x08 of [target+0x1a8]+8; when clearing also clears bit 0 of +0x170 and bit 0x04 of the mirror and calls vt+0x140; finally tail-calls vt+0x70. Callers: Vm_UiTabs_OnMessage (calls with 0 when its vt+0xf8 check is false, result fed to Ne_BusMessage_SubscribeHandlerUnique) and 0x1442685c0 (pin handler: pin 0x146ca4f84 -> 0, pin 0x146ca4f88 -> 1).
